items.html: The thread is still marked active. Its latest summary reports substantial implementation and passing tests, but full compatibility is unfinished. I’m checking the live repository because the thread reader appears to be showing an older checkpoint.

Still active, with substantial progress—but the full rewrite is unfinished. The thread reader showed an older checkpoint, so I checked GitHub directly.

  • Latest pushed commit: c47ac3f (now fd46bca), adding native lattice geometry and basis metadata. (Hosted CI is green).
  • Validation recorded: 1,647 Python tests, 68 Rust tests, strict lint/type checks, and isolated Linux wheel checks including Advect and HDF5.
  • Performance: all 299 measured runtime checks and 295 applicable memory checks pass. Four internal-illumination cases retain memory exemptions.
  • Remaining: complete public API compatibility, some derivative/singular-limit cases, and broader platform qualification. It still uses import treams_rs; it is not yet a drop-in replacement.

The current status document has the details, though some earlier “remaining” entries haven’t caught up with its latest milestones. I verified repository/CI status; I didn’t rerun tests or alter the work.
